thread:
alice: Hey team — customer on proj-314 is seeing invoice tokens ~120k higher than dashboard for March 3-4. Dashboard shows 98,400 tokens, invoice shows 218,600. Can someone take a quick look?
ben: looking ... can you paste the project_id and sample request ids?
alice: project_id=proj-314
alice: sample request ids: r_3f9a, r_3f9b
alice: quick SQL I ran:
```
SELECT project_id, sum(token_count) as tokens
FROM billing_ledger
WHERE project_id='proj-314' AND time >= '2026-03-03' AND time < '2026-03-05'
GROUP BY project_id;
-- returns 218600
```
charlie: the realtime dashboard query (cache path) returns 98,400 for same window
charlie: possible causes: late arriving ledger writes, double counting in org rollup, or window boundary mismatch between ledger and dashboard aggregator
support-bot: New support ticket created: #SUP-4519 (automated)
ben: quick reconcile steps I ran:
```
# fetch per-minute aggregates from ledger and aggregator
python tools/reconcile_metering.py --project proj-314 --from 2026-03-03T00:00Z --to 2026-03-05T00:00Z
# output showed spikes around 2026-03-03T23:59:00Z where ledger has 60k but aggregator has 0
```
ben: looks like a boundary case where the aggregator's rolling window uses local timezone alignment (server tz) and ledger writes are in UTC. When shared org pool attribution runs, some tokens get attributed both to project and org rollup in overlapping windows
alice: can we reproduce by replaying kafka topic 'metering-events' for that minute?
ops: yes, I replayed offsets 12345-12380 to a staging consumer, reproduced ledger write pattern: some messages appeared delayed(~70s) and a follow-up dedupe job didn't run in time
charlie: hypothesis: dedupe window is <= 60s, but delayed messages cross that threshold so ledger accepted them and the aggregator also counted them in the next window. Combined with org-shared-pool fanout, those tokens end up on invoice but dashboard query used aggregated window that filtered duplicates
ben: temporary mitigation: mark those invoice tokens as disputed and issue a credit while we patch the aggregator to normalize windows to UTC and extend dedupe TTL to 120s
alice: can someone open a PR and a followup incident for postmortem? I opened support ticket and customer looped in
ops: opened infra ticket INF-2198, will schedule a hotfix to the aggregator config (UTC alignment + dedupe TTL)
charlie: paste of minimal repro command:
```
# replay to staging consumer
tools/kafka_replay --topic metering-events --start 12345 --end 12380 --env staging
# run reconcile
python tools/reconcile_metering.py --project proj-314 --from 2026-03-03T23:58Z --to 2026-03-04T00:02Z --compare
```
alice: thanks — I'll notify the customer of a provisional credit and ETA for fix :thumbsup:
ben: saving logs+offsets to S3 at s3://redwood-debug/proj-314/march3/ for postmortem
charlie: followup: add unit test for rolling-window alignment and add integration test for delayed messages
support-bot: Ticket #SUP-4519 updated: customer notified of provisional credit (billing@)...
ops: hotfix deployed to staging; will promote to prod after 1h smoke tests
alice: closing loop for now, will re-open if numbers don't match after deploy
